latin: Nec crux Christi nec ulla imago adoranda est adoratione latriae, etiam eo modo quo ponit Thommas.

mentions.context: VIII condemned thirteen of the prince’s propositions within weeks after the Conclusions appeared. To answer the Pope’s indictment point by point, Pico divided his Apology into thirteen parts, called “Questions.” My book discusses these Questions, labeled Q1, Q2, Q3 and so on, while focusing on six of them.
